containerImages.name: Orbit base image (Alpine plus Node from official signed source)

unwatchedImages.reason: CI job image (NODE_IMAGE); ships nothing to operators. A `_IMAGE:` pin in .gitlab-ci.yml, which Renovate's CI-variables regex (renovate.json) proposes updates for; not watched by sidecar-pins.

CI browser image (PLAYWRIGHT_IMAGE); it must match the image the design fidelity baselines were measured on, so a bump moves with those baselines. Ships nothing to operators. A `_IMAGE:` pin in .gitlab-ci.yml, which Renovate's CI-variables regex (renovate.json) proposes updates for; not watched by sidecar-pins.
CI acceptance image built by the orbit-base-image pipeline; its digest comes from that pipeline, as the base image's does, not from a registry tag. Ships nothing to operators.
CI signing image built by the orbit-base-image pipeline; its digest comes from that pipeline, not from a registry tag. Ships nothing to operators.

CI toolchain image (GOLANG_IMAGE) that builds the launcher binaries; the image itself ships nothing to operators. A `_IMAGE:` pin in .gitlab-ci.yml, which Renovate's CI-variables regex (renovate.json) proposes updates for; not watched by sidecar-pins.

CI Docker-in-Docker service for the image-building jobs; ships nothing to operators. Pinned under an `image:`/`services:` key in .gitlab-ci.yml, which Renovate's gitlabci manager proposes updates for; not watched by sidecar-pins.

CI Docker client image for the image-building jobs; ships nothing to operators. Pinned under an `image:`/`services:` key in .gitlab-ci.yml, which Renovate's gitlabci manager proposes updates for; not watched by sidecar-pins.

CI image for the weekly dependency-update job; ships nothing to operators. Pinned under an `image:`/`services:` key in .gitlab-ci.yml, which Renovate's gitlabci manager proposes updates for; not watched by sidecar-pins.
Throwaway mail server for the acceptance stack; never part of a deployment. In a compose file Renovate's docker-compose manager proposes updates for; not watched by sidecar-pins.

Demo-only TLS front end, never part of a release. In a compose file Renovate's docker-compose manager proposes updates for; not watched by sidecar-pins. Not in containerImages because sidecar-pins checks each file for the linux/amd64 digest while this file pins the multi-architecture index digest (#1490).

Throwaway registry the installer tests push to; never part of a deployment. Its CI copy (ORBIT_INSTALLER_REGISTRY_IMAGE) is a `_IMAGE:` pin Renovate proposes updates for; the scripts' fallback defaults are not seen by Renovate and move by hand with it. Not in containerImages because sidecar-pins checks each file for the linux/amd64 digest while these files pin the multi-architecture index digest (#1490).

Tika image for the developer-run extract-bundle tool, version from scripts/extract-bundle/tika-version.mjs. Renovate cannot read the template reference, so it does not watch it; instead scripts/extract-bundle/build.test.mjs requires the version and digest to equal the deployment's orbit-tika pin in docker-compose.yml (#1489), so it moves with the watched image.

deploymentImageReferences.rule: A deployment must run an immutable digest. A mutable tag may be resolved to a digest; it may never be deployed.
